luma.provenance: The blue shirt is an original AI-generated input image. The screenshots show local editing, not hosted image generation. Native RAW and print features vary.

screenshots.caption: Review PNG, JPEG, WebP, PSD and native project options.

ghost.provenance: An original AI-generated front reference was reused for both photo slots in this demonstration. The resulting study is an approximation, not calibrated fit or an exact sewing pattern.

screenshots.title: Take the study with you
screenshots.caption: Choose a GLB, preview image or editable project backup.

scenepilot.provenance: Original synthetic test footage. These are Browser Lite captures; the full native Pro workspaces have a different feature set. Browser codec and export support varies.

librarian.provenance: Original demonstration PDFs. Retain your source files: browser storage can be cleared. These captures demonstrate local reading, not hosted AI.

reclaim.provenance: The browser companion only reviews selected files. It cannot scan the whole Mac, clear caches, quarantine or delete files.

screenshots.title: Keep a report
screenshots.caption: Export the review as a report. The source files remain unchanged.

stemdeck.provenance: The browser companion mixes loaded audio. Native stem separation, plugins, tempo/key algorithms and Replay are not part of this edition.

screenshots.caption: Play the loaded decks and blend the two sides with a crossfader.

screenshots.title: Keep the sketch
screenshots.caption: Export a short stereo WAV from the selected cues and current mix settings.

bounce.provenance: The browser companion plays local audio with EQ and saved playlists. Native metadata scanning and streaming services are not included.
